item.title: 71 Disappointing Tourist Attractions Locals Still Don’t Get
item.description: Travel can be great, but hype isn’t your friend. When you stay grounded and realistic, you can be pleasantly surprised. But when you have huge expectations for how your adventure will turn out, you’re just waiting in line for disappointment. The reality is that not all tourist attractions are all that they’re cracked up to be. item.title: 80 Relatable Memes That Hit Way Too Close To Home
item.description: As you scroll through social media, you will likely find a piece of content that resonates with you. It could be a photo, video, or meme that you feel expresses your sentiments at that very moment. You may find a lot of those in these posts, which we collected from the WTF Memes Facebook group. Scroll through and see what you can find.

item.title: 95 Of The Weirdest And Most Unhinged Things Seen On The Streets Of Brussels
item.description: Every city is unique. And if you live in any place long enough, you'll start to understand just how quirky and bizarre it is too. But apparently, one place that has plenty of quirks is Brussels. This capital city is full of gorgeous architecture, delicious chocolate, and countless sights that might make you wonder what the heck is going on there. Here's a list of the most entertaining and inexplicable things people have casually encountered on the streets of Brussels.

item.title: All You Can Eat Buffet Employees Share The Most “Disgusting Display Of Gluttony” They Have Ever Seen
item.description: Gluttons glutton in different ways. Homer Simpson, for example, developed the ability to hear pudding. But the gluttons that these all-you-can-eat buffet employees have seen are a different breed. item.title: Man Feels Torn Between His Husband And His Mother‑In‑Law After Secretly Helping Her
item.description: Infidelity is a sure-fire way to ruin relationships, not just with the significant other, but with everyone around them. This woman’s affair not only tore her family apart, but it also poisoned her once-close connection with her son-in-law. Things worsened when the son-in-law helped her during a time of need, sparking a full-blown family drama.

item.title: Dad Takes Son Out To Celebrate After He Punches A Bully, Ex Wife Thinks That’s A Horrible Idea
item.description: For some kids, bullying feels far worse than exams or pop quizzes. They often find themselves stuck between a rock and a hard place, wondering whether to stand up to the bullies or just turn a blind eye. A man was proud of his son when he stepped in to protect a girl at school who was being bullied for months — even punching one of the bullies in the process. But after his ex-wife’s strong reaction, he turned to the internet to see if he or his son were in the wrong.

item.title: 62 Medical Facts That Sound Made Up Even Though They Are True
item.description: Day to day, we exist in our bodies without thinking much about them. We wake up, eat, move around, and fall asleep again, all without pausing to consider what’s happening beneath the surface. But once you start thinking about how humans actually function—organs, nerves, hormones, all of it—you realize there’s no shortage of surprising details. One Redditor asked users to share medical facts that sound fake but are actually true, and they delivered plenty of fascinating trivia.

item.title: 47 Times The Internet Fell For A Photo That Wasn’t What It Seemed
item.description: What you think you know isn’t always correct. Just because a false claim gets repeated over and over again doesn’t make it true. And not everything that you see in a photo is actually what happened. Our team has collected some of the most commonly shared photos from around the internet that either have a fake story attached to them or fooled others with their edits, as shared in these two online threads. Luckily, the internet is full of amateur sleuths who were happy to show the truth.

item.title: 62 Kids With No Filter Revealed Family Lore Teachers Didn’t Need To Know
item.description: Kids have no filter, and we love collecting all the unhinged things they say. One group of people who has an endless supply of these gems is teachers. So when someone on the internet asked them to share the craziest family lore a student has told them, the replies immediately flew in. From embarrassing injury reports to confessions about secret relatives, I guess it's easier to spill the tea when you're still figuring out the rules of the world.

item.title: 79 Times People Were Rushing To Take A Pic Of Animals Making Silly Faces (New Pics)
item.description: Seeing a cat that spends roughly half the day sleeping and living in luxury, having an expression like it finished an eighteen hour shift in a coal mine can be rather amusing. So we’ve gathered some of the funniest, cutest and derpiest pictures of animals with hilarious facial expressions.
